name: vertexsms
description: Send SMS, track delivery, check prices and balance, validate phone numbers and manage Sender IDs on your VertexSMS account.

interface.longDescription:
VertexSMS is a business SMS platform. This plugin connects the assistant to your own VertexSMS account.

Messaging
- Send an SMS to one recipient, now or at a scheduled time, and check whether it was delivered.

Prices and balance
- Look up SMS prices per country and operator, in EUR.
- Check your account balance.

Phone numbers
- Convert numbers to international format and tell mobile numbers from landlines.
- Look up mobile prefixes and network codes (MCC/MNC) of a country.
- Run a live HLR lookup to see the current operator of a number and whether it was ported.

Sender IDs
- List the Sender IDs on your account and their status.
- Submit a new sender name for approval, or register your own mobile number as a sender and confirm it with a PIN.

Cost and confirmation
Sending an SMS and running an HLR lookup are billed to your VertexSMS account at your usual prices, and messages go to real phones. These tools, and the tools that change your account, are marked as such, so the assistant asks you to confirm before each call. Looking up prices, balance, delivery status, Sender IDs and number formats is free and read-only.

Requirements
You need a VertexSMS account. Accounts are opened on request at vertexsms.com. You connect by signing in with your VertexSMS account and approving the permissions you want to grant; no API key is needed.

Data
The server is a stateless bridge to the VertexSMS API. It stores no messages, phone numbers or credentials.
